purpose: Define how errors propagate through command, Runner step, nested Routine, protocol and DWH boundaries without losing original cause or masquerading as unrelated failures.

topics.name: Runtime Error Propagation
topics.purpose: Define how errors propagate through command, Runner step, nested Routine, protocol and DWH boundaries without losing original cause or masquerading as unrelated failures.

semantics.cause_rule: Propagated error retains exact originating error/cause refs.
semantics.boundary_rule: Each boundary may wrap/classify an error but never erase original provenance.
semantics.runner_rule: Step failure propagates according to explicit Runner failure policy.
semantics.protocol_rule: Transport/protocol mapping preserves internal error identity while exposing policy-safe external representation.
semantics.nested_rule: Nested Routine failure retains child execution/error refs.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive details may be redacted externally without deleting internal evidence.
semantics.success_rule: Propagated failure never becomes success solely because a boundary handled formatting.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: wrapped error loses child execution ref
protocol returns success for failed operation without explicit partial semantics

references.purpose: Runner propagation follows explicit recovery semantics.
